- Connection limits: a full request line must arrive within 5 s (CAT-074 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:32`); a line over 1 MiB drops the connection without a JSON error (CAT-075 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:34`).
- Errors: server-layer codes are invalid_request, unknown_method, server_unavailable, connection_local_only, timeout, internal_error, invalid_ssh_agent, ssh_agent_unavailable (CAT-095 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:1034`); invalid_request echoes the id only when it can be recovered safely (CAT-080 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:359`); after `server.stop` every other request gets server_unavailable (CAT-094 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:593`).
- Socket discovery: `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` names the API socket (CAT-063 `herdr/src/api/mod.rs:20`); otherwise a named session resolves to `sessions/<name>/herdr.sock` (CAT-062 `herdr/src/api/client.rs:16`).
- Versioning: the schema declares socket protocol version 22 (CAT-2809 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:3`); the CLI pings for the protocol version before each request and aborts on mismatch (CAT-583 `herdr/src/cli.rs:790`); `ServerCapabilities` flags default to false so old servers parse (CAT-009 `herdr/src/api/schema/server.rs:42`).
- Method families (from the published schema): `ping`, `server.*` (live_handoff, reload_config, ssh_agent.register, agent_manifests) (CAT-2817 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:4687`); `notification.show`, `command.invoke`, `client.window_title.*`, `client_shell.surface.set` (CAT-2823 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:4799`); `session.snapshot` (CAT-2828 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:4911`); `workspace.*` (CAT-2829 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:4927`); `worktree.*` (CAT-2837 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:5071`); `tab.*` (CAT-2840 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:5135`); `agent.list/get/read/explain/send_keys/rename/view.*/focus/start/prompt/wait` (CAT-2846 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:5247`); `pane.*` and `layout.*` (split, swap, move, zoom, read, send_text, send_keys, send_input, report_agent, report_metadata, release_agent) (CAT-2858 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:5439`); `events.subscribe`, `events.wait`, `pane.wait_for_output` (CAT-2886 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:6047`); `integration.*` (CAT-2889 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:6095`); `plugin.*` (CAT-2892 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:6143`).
- Events: `events.subscribe` holds the connection open, replies `subscription_started` then one JSON line per event (CAT-082 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:428`)(CAT-085 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:845`); the subscription list is fixed in the one request and any setup error rejects the whole stream (CAT-083 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:811`).
- Event kinds: 26 kinds with stable dot names, including pane.output_changed (revision) and layout.updated (CAT-051 `herdr/src/api/schema/events.rs:194`); the schema lists workspace, worktree, tab, pane, agent-status and layout events (CAT-2813 `herdr/docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json:730`).
- Event history and loss: the hub keeps the last 512 events with u64 sequence numbers (CAT-055 `herdr/src/api/event_hub.rs:19`); a subscriber that falls behind gets `events_lost` ("resubscribe and resync with session.snapshot") and the stream ends (CAT-109 `herdr/src/api/subscriptions.rs:331`); delivery is polled every 100 ms rather than pushed (CAT-072 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:30`).
- Waits: `events.wait` blocks until a match, timeout, disconnect or shutdown (CAT-087 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:450`) but only supports pane agent status matches (CAT-122 `herdr/src/api/wait.rs:775`); `pane.output_matched` is edge-triggered and sampled by re-reading the pane (CAT-101 `herdr/src/api/subscriptions.rs:376`); an initial synthetic status event fires when the filter already matches (CAT-107 `herdr/src/api/subscriptions.rs:214`).
- Connection-scoped leases: `server.ssh_agent.register` holds its connection open and the lease ends when it closes (CAT-081 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:386`); `client_shell.surface.set` returns connection_local_only on the public socket (CAT-092 `herdr/src/api/server.rs:574`).

### herdr-core JSON-RPC: plain mode

- A connection starts in plain mode: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line (CAT-3700 `herdr-core/schema/README.md:23`); the CLI makes one plain call (request id 1, one reply line) per connection (CAT-3038 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/client.rs:231`).
- `hello` returns generation, version, core identity, method names and features (CAT-3195 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api.rs:56`); generation is 1 and a different requested generation fails with `unsupported_generation` (CAT-3190 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api.rs:15`); features are framed, attach, events, status, shell (CAT-3191 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api.rs:16`).
- `terminal.attach` on a plain connection fails with kind `needs_framed` (CAT-3119 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:406`); `hello`, `doc.get` and `doc.set` are API-only with no CLI command (CAT-3309 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/cli.rs:863`).
- After `events.subscribe` a plain connection carries only notification lines and ignores further client lines (CAT-3112 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:223`).
- A plain `machine.exec` aborts when its caller closes the socket; framed callers can send `$/cancelRequest {id}` (CAT-3117 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:152`).

### herdr-core JSON-RPC: framed mode and frame kinds

- `hello` with `{"framed": true}` switches the connection to framed mode after its reply; attach requires framed mode (CAT-3702 `herdr-core/schema/README.md:34`)(CAT-3268 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api/types.rs:103`).
- Frame layout `[channel u32 LE][kind u8][len u32 LE][payload]`, 9-byte header (CAT-3166 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:1`); channel 0 carries JSON-RPC and each attach stream gets its own channel (CAT-3167 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:2`); payload max 16 MiB (CAT-3168 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:8`).
- Kind 0 DATA: JSON-RPC on channel 0, raw terminal bytes on streams (CAT-3169 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:11`).
- Kind 1 CREDIT: u32 LE count of bytes consumed; the sender may send that many more (CAT-3170 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:13`).
- Kind 2 CLOSE: channel over, JSON reason from the core, empty from a client (CAT-3171 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:15`).
- Kind 3 RESIZE: viewer to core, u16 LE cols and rows (input row H-core-src-3-008 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:17`, neutral, not in the catalog).
- Kind 4 FOCUS: viewer to core, 1 = gained focus, 0 = lost (input row H-core-src-3-009 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:19`, neutral, not in the catalog).
- Kind 5 FACTS: viewer to core, JSON display facts (colors, cell size) (CAT-3172 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:21`).
- Flow control: each stream starts with 256 KiB credit (CAT-3173 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:24`); at most 4 MiB is buffered for a non-reading viewer before a repaint (CAT-3174 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:26`); at most 64 MiB of replies for a non-reading client before disconnect (CAT-3175 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:28`)(CAT-3116 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:185`); stream DATA frames are at most 16 KiB (input row H-core-src-3-014 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:29`).
- Scheduling: control frames always go first, streams share the rest round-robin within their credit (CAT-3181 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/wire.rs:152`); channel-0 calls run concurrently (CAT-3115 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:292`).

### OSC 7501 status

- Record fields: state (idle, working, done, blocked, error), kind (permission, question, auth), progress 0..100, app, title, msg; stored exactly as reported (CAT-3122 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/status.rs:14`).
- Wire form: `ESC ] 7501 ; state=..:id=..:kind=..:progress=..:app=..:title=<b64>:msg=<b64> ESC \` (CAT-3123 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/status.rs:44`)(CAT-3531 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/tests/m3.rs:24`).
- Records: a report replaces its record; no id = root status, an id = child record; `clear` wipes all or one id subtree (CAT-3126 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/status.rs:96`).
- Query: a program sends `ESC]7501;?ESC\` and the core answers on terminal input with `ESC]7501;?:states=...` (CAT-3581 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/tests/windows.rs:649`).
- Turn: `Terminal.turn` increments each time the root record leaves working (CAT-3125 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/status.rs:74`).
- New viewers get the latest OSC 7501 root and records right after the screen paint (CAT-3154 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/viewers.rs:281`).
- The core never infers status; programs that do not speak OSC 7501 have no status (CAT-3628 `herdr-core/README.md:43`)(CAT-3722 `herdr-core/schema/README.md:132`).

### herdr-core events, seq, heartbeat and missed

- Events are JSON-RPC notifications `event` with params type, terminal, data and seq; `missed` carries a fresh snapshot; `heartbeat` carries seq (CAT-3047 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:65`).
- seq is global and monotonic; the subscribe snapshot reports the seq it is current at (CAT-3052 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:131`)(CAT-3286 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api/types.rs:393`).
- Event names: created, lost, restarted, keep, finished, removed, status, turn, title, labels, size, doc, plus heartbeat and missed (CAT-3754 `herdr-core/schema/hc.openrpc.json:3409`); filters are terminal, children_of and labels (CAT-3046 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:23`).
- Heartbeat: every 15 s by default, configurable with `HC_HEARTBEAT_MS`, carrying the event seq (CAT-3113 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:217`); the events module sends it on framed subscriptions (CAT-3051 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:210`) and plain-mode subscriptions start no heartbeat task (CAT-3227 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api.rs:538`), which conflicts with the schema README's blanket 15 s heartbeat (CAT-3715 `herdr-core/schema/README.md:106`).
- missed: a plain subscriber may queue 1024 events (CAT-3045 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:14`); past that the queue is dropped and replaced by one `missed` line with a fresh snapshot, and a subscriber unwritable for 30 s is dropped (CAT-3114 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/server.rs:243`).
- After a `missed` snapshot, ignore events whose seq is not above the snapshot seq (CAT-3287 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api/types.rs:409`)(CAT-3757 `herdr-core/schema/hc.openrpc.json:1042`).
- Remote: a mirrored `missed` is re-emitted with the local seq (CAT-3434 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/remote/tests.rs:49`); filtered subscribers do not receive a remote `missed` with empty terminals (CAT-3437 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/remote/tests.rs:50`); machine change loss sends `missed` to unfiltered subscribers (CAT-3050 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:174`).

### doc.get / doc.set

- `doc.get` returns a named opaque JSON document and its version; unknown names yield null with version 0 (CAT-3228 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api/doc.rs:4`); an optional `on` routes it to a machine (CAT-3219 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api.rs:124`).
- `doc.set` is compare-and-swap: pass the current version or get `conflict` with a hint to re-read (CAT-3229 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api/doc.rs:16`); values up to 1 MiB, null deletes but keeps the version, persisted atomically (CAT-3220 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api.rs:127`).
- A successful set emits a `doc` event carrying only {name, version}; subscribers refetch with `doc.get` (CAT-3231 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/api/doc.rs:37`)(CAT-3479 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/tests/docs.rs:22`); doc events go only to unfiltered subscribers (CAT-3049 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/src/events.rs:122`).
- Recovery: subscribe before reading and refetch after reconnect or `missed`, since there is no document replay (CAT-3721 `herdr-core/schema/README.md:126`)(CAT-3482 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/tests/docs.rs:122`); a corrupt docs.json is renamed docs.json.bad (CAT-3481 `herdr-core/crates/herdr-core/tests/docs.rs:48`).
